steps.npc: Buying cabbage am I, not have such thing where I from. Will pay money much handsome for wondrous object, cabbage you called.
Say I 100 gold coins each fair price to be giving yes?

steps.text: If the player does not have any cabbages:

steps.player: Alas, I have no cabbages either...

steps.npc: Pity be that, I want badly do.

steps.text: If the player has any cabbages:

options.text: Yes, I will sell you all my cabbages.

steps.player: Yes, I'll sell you all my cabbages.

steps.npc: Business good doing with you! Please, again come, buying always.

options.text: No, I will keep my cabbbages.

steps.player: No, I will keep my cabbbages.
